tasks.label: bench-status
tasks.command: echo '== health =='; curl -s 127.0.0.1:8788/health; echo; echo '== dev =='; curl -s 127.0.0.1:8787/api/status; echo; echo '== providers =='; curl -s 127.0.0.1:8787/api/providers; echo; echo '== procs =='; pgrep -fa 'rex-key-fill|rex-dev-server' | sed 's/ .*rex/ rex/'

tasks.label: bench-restart-key-fill
tasks.command: pkill -x rex-key-fill; sleep 1; nohup $HOME/bin/rex-key-fill --port 8788 --provider gemini >>$HOME/bench/rex-key-fill.log 2>&1 & sleep 1; curl -s 127.0.0.1:8788/health

tasks.label: bench-stop-key-fill
tasks.command: pkill -x rex-key-fill; sleep 1; pgrep -x rex-key-fill || echo KEY-FILL-STOPPED

tasks.label: bench-pip
tasks.command: python3 -m pip install --user --break-system-packages -q 'evalplus==0.3.1' requests datasets && python3 -c "import evalplus; print('EVALPLUS-OK')"
